caption: The drawing depicts a figure representing a toy or a puppet with jointed limbs. The figure is wearing a light blue cap, a grey long-sleeved top with a light blue ribbon tied at the neck, and matching grey shorts. It has bright red stockings and black shoes. The arms and legs are joined to the body with visible hinge joints. The figure holds a beige ball in each hand, with the left arm raised higher than the right, and the position of the body suggests motion or balancing. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there are faint yellowish marks around the figure. The entire figure is rendered with a muted, soft color palette, and the artist's signature, "DANIGER," is visible in small text beneath the left foot of the figure.
title: Mechanical Toy
